text:
Maria: Quick sync — we're onboarding otter13b-lite to hosted + dedicated. Need rollout checklist and canary config. Key constraints: 2.5x speedup vs baseline, acceptable ROUGE drop <=2.0 on summarization. Anyone owning canary?
Jake: I can lead canary for hosted.
Priya: Do we have quantization results? int8 vs int4 perf/quality?
Maria: int8 results: latency p50 38ms (seq512), p99 220ms; int4 experimental: p50 30ms but hallucination rate up ~3.5%. Eval summary: `ROUGE-L: baseline 42.1 -> int8 41.6 -> int4 39.8`
Tom: Noted. Can we run targeted eval on our 120-sample safety prompt set?
Priya: Already ran 2k sample on holdout: int8 regression mostly within noise except one abstractive prompt cluster — Sophie, want to share example?
Sophie: example: prompt id 8421: baseline -> "Dr. Lina Park wrote a new paper on neural compilers." otter-int8 -> "Dr. Lina Parke wrote a new paper...". Attaching snippet: ```input: "Summarize news about Dr. Lina Park."
baseline: "Dr. Lina Park ..."
otter-int8: "Dr. Lina Parke..."```
Maria: ok that's worrying. Proposed plan: stage canary on hosted 1% traffic -> metrics to watch: lat/err/ROUGE/regression-alerts. Fallback policy: immediate traffic cut to otter13b-full on regression >1% critical errors or increase in hallucination >2% over baseline.
Tom: here's a canary config I used before: ```policy: canary
hosts: hosted
percentage: 1
duration: 2h
metrics: [p50_latency, p99_latency, rouge_l, hallucination_rate]
thresholds: {p99_latency: 500, rouge_l_drop: 2, hallucination_increase: 1.5}```
Priya: also run dedicated dry-run with same model pinned to a reserved pool, simulate 100qps for 30m. Check KV-cache priming.
Jake: I'll schedule hosted canary for tomorrow 10:00 PT and coordinate with SRE to watch. @deploy-bot can you kickoff smoke probes then?
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary job queued: otter13b-lite-hosted-canary at 2026-03-21T17:00:00Z (job id: cb-7802).
Sophie: add a human eval pass for the entity-sensitive prompts and a small LM-based rerank check to catch swapped names.
Maria: agree. Final checklist short: 1) int8 vs int4 quality baseline table, 2) safety prompt set pass, 3) hosted 1% canary 2h, 4) dedicated 30m dry-run 100qps, 5) rollback triggers documented, 6) post-canary A/B with 5% for 24h, 7) update model catalog entry + changelog.
Jake: :thumbsup: I'll create the runbook and update the ticket (#INF-4821).
Priya: adding eval artifacts to S3: s3://redwood-evals/otter13b-lite/2026-03-21/
Maria: thanks everyone. Let's sync after canary — if any blocker ping #eng-ml and @oncall. :eyes:
